title: HQ-PARITY-3, two players: OPENING a partner's logistics plan sends nothing and can never overwrite the owner's plan; a single destination edit still travels as one op; and every setting a control writes - purchasing repeating/auto-stock, HR replace-absent and training target, headhunter deal-breakers - is on the other machine inside four seconds, in both directions; ends dissolved with nothing left behind, NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1. Build HQ-PARITY-3 deployed on both machines. FIXTURE REQUIREMENT: the HOST's own headquarters must hold (a) one LOGISTICS plan (not a factory plan) with a manager, a source warehouse, a truck AND a driver in one of that warehouse's vehicle slots - only that makes MaxDestinations non-zero - and at least one destination row; (b) one PURCHASING plan (import partnership); (c) one HR plan; (d) one HEADHUNTER plan. Steps 14-19 are the LOAD-IS-NOT-AN-EDIT assertions and need only (a). Steps 20-25 are the destination round trip and need (a) with a destination. Steps 26-34 are the per-control publish and need (b), (c) and (d): drop the family's two steps if the fixture has no plan of it. The rig draws no screen: hqlog load drives the open seam directly when no plan list is on screen and says which path it took, and every setting is read back through `plans <owner> rows <family>`, which prints the values the panes' own controls are drawn from.
oracles_absent: \[Plans\] redraw for .* DEFERRED - a headhunter plan is open
\[Plans\] redraw for .* DEFERRED - a purchasing product row is expanded
the HR controls are not hooked
oracles_report: \[Merger\] plan .* cannot be expressed as logistics ops
\[Plans\] refreshed the open .* pane in place

steps.note: the worlds settle and the first paperwork bundles cross
the host's logistics plan as the client holds it, with the OWNER's capacity (A6 keeps that number once it has been seen, so a momentarily absent DTO can no longer grey every row)
the owner's own plan count BEFORE the client so much as looks at it

A1 DIAGNOSTIC, A REPORT NOT A FAIL. `identical` is expected on a plan whose open has already been captured; `differs at <n>` names the first byte at which the copy's serialised shape and this machine's baseline part, which is exactly the asymmetry that used to turn an OPEN into a whole-plan edit. Either answer passes: what step 18 asserts is that the load sends nothing whatever the shapes say.

A1, THE ASSERTION: running the real open of a partner's display copy sends ZERO legs. Before this build the load postfix routed, and the hands-on run caught it sending a WHOLE-PLAN replace with no user edit at all (host :3105-3108, client :2750). `via=` says whether the list's own SelectPlan ran or the seam was driven directly - the rig opens no screen, so `via=seam` is the ordinary answer.
longer than the 2 s urgent publish plus the host's store-and-fan-out: if anything HAD been routed, it would have landed by now

A2, THE OWNER'S PLAN IS UNTOUCHED: the count is the one captured at step 15. The `whole plan:` line and the `installed untagged` line of the replace-by-id install are both in oracles_absent for the WHOLE run, so a single whole-plan leg anywhere in this scenario fails it.
and the client's own copy still shows the same destinations it showed before the load
A2: a REAL edit still travels, and as a single op on the mergerplanedit carrier
the member's own copy shows the removal came back through the owner's urgent publish
8 -> 7 -> 8: the round trip closes, and no whole-plan leg was sent in either direction
B6: the purchasing rows now print `rep=<bool> auto=<bool>`, the two toggles the owner drives
B4/B6: the owner-side control commits at the urgent cadence instead of riding the 30 s dirty publish
B5's field, published from the owner
the count went up by the one the owner just added

B5, THE OTHER DIRECTION: the member presses the HR toggle on the partner's plan. Before this build the control had no patch at all - its listener is an anonymous lambda inside HrManagerPlanUI.LoadPlan - and the press wrote the detached copy and was dropped.
the owner's REAL plan took the member's edit and published it back
FIXTURE HYGIENE: end dissolved; NO save. The host's settings are left as the run left them in memory and are never written to disk
DISSOLVE LEG (user question 2026-09-12): off the merger the member holds NO partner rows at all - the display copies, their baselines and the held edits all cleared with the company
the ex-partner's logistics rows are gone from this machine

off the merger the host's own plan count is exactly what it was at step 15: nothing this run did replaced a plan object
